title.narrative: CONSENT: Enhancement of alternative dispute resolution (ADR) in Ukraine with focus on mediation

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to provide the population with an access to alternative ways of settling disputes, in particular, mediation and arbitrage. Specific objectives include: 1. Legislative and institutional frameworks on ADR are brought closer in line with European standards and good practices of EU states 2. Improved access and quality of mediation services. 3. Promoting culture of peaceful resolution of disputes in Ukrainian society for more tolerant and resilient communities
